assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The denial was issued because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient presents with intermittent lightheadedness.
The symptoms are consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for continuous rhythm assessment.
The monitoring is intended to accurately correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and optimize rate control management.
